app = Flask(__name__)
def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect("users.db")
    c = conn.cursor()

    c.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        email TEXT UNIQUE,
        password TEXT
    )
    """)

    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

init_db()
